name: readFile
title: Read file
description: Reads a workspace file or a container absolute path. Reads are bounded by line and byte limits; continue from start_line when the output is truncated.

parameters.name: path
parameters.descriptionZh: 文件路径（工作区相对路径或容器绝对路径）

parameters.name: start_line
parameters.description: Start line (continue after a truncated read)
parameters.descriptionZh: 起始行号（内容被截断时从上次位置继续）

parameters.name: end_line
parameters.descriptionZh: 结束行号

descriptionZh: 读取工作区文件或容器内绝对路径文件，带行数与字节上限，内容被截断时可从起始行继续读取。

name: writeFile
title: Write file
description: Creates or fully rewrites a file, creating missing parent directories automatically.

parameters.name: path
parameters.descriptionZh: 目标文件路径

parameters.name: content
parameters.descriptionZh: 完整文件内容

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: Overwrite if the file already exists
parameters.descriptionZh: 目标已存在时是否覆盖（默认需要）

descriptionZh: 新建或整体重写一个文件，可自动创建缺失的父目录。

name: editFile
title: Edit file
description: Edits an existing file by exact string match. Multiple edits can be applied in one atomic batch (any failure rolls all back). Preferred for local edits; use writeFile to rewrite a whole file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.descriptionZh: 目标文件路径

parameters.name: edits
parameters.description: Edit list; each item has old_string / new_string
parameters.descriptionZh: 编辑列表，每项含 old_string / new_string

parameters.name: replace_all
parameters.description: Replace every occurrence when old_string matches multiple times
parameters.descriptionZh: old_string 可多处匹配时是否全部替换

descriptionZh: 按精确字符串匹配编辑既有文件，一次可批量提交多处原子性修改（任一处失败整体回滚）。本地小改动优先用本工具，整体重写用 writeFile。

name: list
title: List files
description: Lists directory contents in ls style with common ls options; supports appending `| head` to truncate output.

parameters.name: args
parameters.descriptionZh: ls 参数与路径，如 "-la ~/workspace/app"

descriptionZh: 以 ls 风格列出目录内容，支持常用 ls 选项与 `| head` 截断输出。

name: search
title: Search code
description: Full-text search powered by ripgrep (rg) with regex support, path filtering, and `| head` output truncation.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: rg arguments and pattern, e.g. "-n \"fun main\" ~/workspace/app"
parameters.descriptionZh: rg 参数与搜索词，如 "-n \"fun main\" ~/workspace/app"

descriptionZh: 基于 ripgrep (rg) 的全文搜索，支持正则、按目录过滤与 `| head` 截断输出。

name: sendFile
title: Send file
description: Sends workspace files to the user as chat attachments. Supports text, images and common binary types, with optional renaming.

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: List of file paths to send
parameters.descriptionZh: 要发送的文件路径列表

parameters.name: names
parameters.descriptionZh: 与 paths 一一对应的展示文件名

descriptionZh: 把工作区文件作为聊天附件发送给用户，支持文本、图片与常见二进制类型，可附带重命名。

name: viewImage
title: View image
description: Reads local images and sends them to a vision model. Multiple images can be compared at once; a vision_id continues the same vision session.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: Image paths (starts a new vision session)
parameters.descriptionZh: 图片路径列表（开始新的视觉会话）

parameters.name: id
parameters.descriptionZh: 已有 vision_id（延续同一会话）

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Question or analysis request about the images
parameters.descriptionZh: 对图片的提问或分析要求

descriptionZh: 读取本地图片并交给视觉模型分析，支持一次传多张图对比，vision_id 可延续同一视觉会话。

name: Bash
title: Run command
description: Runs a one-shot shell command and returns output synchronously. The default environment follows the user's preference; set env to device (host Android) or container (full Linux toolchain). Use the terminal tool instead for long-running tasks.

parameters.name: command
parameters.descriptionZh: 要执行的 shell 命令

parameters.name: env
parameters.descriptionZh: 执行环境：device / container / auto

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.descriptionZh: 超时秒数

parameters.name: elevate
parameters.description: Set true to request one-time user authorization when a built-in safety rule blocks the command
parameters.descriptionZh: 触发内置安全拦截时可置 true 改为请求用户一次性授权

descriptionZh: 同步执行一条 shell 命令并返回输出。默认跟随用户偏好的执行环境，可用 env 指定 device（安卓宿主）或 container（完整 Linux 工具链）。长驻或耗时任务请改用 terminal 工具。

name: terminal
title: Background terminal
description: Manages persistent background terminal sessions: start a command, send input/keys, read output, close tabs. Use notify=true for tasks that exit on their own (the system notifies when done); use notify=false for resident services and read when needed.

parameters.name: command
parameters.descriptionZh: action=start 时要启动的命令

parameters.name: tab_id
parameters.descriptionZh: 目标终端标签 id（send/read/close）

parameters.name: input
parameters.descriptionZh: action=send 时写入的文本输入

parameters.name: key
parameters.descriptionZh: 发送按键，如 ctrl+c

parameters.name: notify
parameters.description: For start: notify when the task finishes
parameters.descriptionZh: start 时任务结束是否通知

descriptionZh: 管理持久后台终端会话：启动命令、发送输入/按键、读取输出、关闭标签页。可自动退出的任务用 notify=true，完成时系统会通知；常驻服务用 notify=false 按需读取。

name: Shizuku
title: Shizuku host control
description: Runs commands on the host Android system via Shizuku (adb shell identity), e.g. installing apps or granting permissions. High-risk: every call requires user confirmation.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Command to run on the host
parameters.descriptionZh: 要在宿主上执行的命令

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.descriptionZh: 超时秒数

descriptionZh: 经 Shizuku（adb shell 身份）在安卓宿主上执行命令，用于 app 安装、授予权限等宿主操作。高危操作，每次都需要用户确认。

name: websearch
title: Web search
description: Searches the internet for up-to-date information. Use when the task needs current or time-sensitive facts.

parameters.name: query
parameters.descriptionZh: 精确、可检索的搜索短语

descriptionZh: 搜索互联网获取最新信息；任务需要实时或时效性事实时使用。

name: webfetch
title: Web fetch
description: Fetches an HTTP/HTTPS page; can extract clean body text or return raw HTML.

parameters.name: url
parameters.descriptionZh: 页面地址

parameters.name: format
parameters.descriptionZh: text（默认，正文纯文本）/ html（原始 HTML）

descriptionZh: 抓取 HTTP/HTTPS 页面，可提取正文纯文本或返回原始 HTML。

name: github
title: GitHub read
description: Reads GitHub data for a repository: list/get issues, issue comments, list/get pull requests, a PR's unified diff, and CI check runs for a ref. Defaults to the workspace remote, or pass repo="owner/repo". Requires a stored github.com token in the credentials manager.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: list_issues / get_issue / list_issue_comments / list_pulls / get_pull / get_pull_diff / list_checks

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as "owner/repo"; defaults to the workspace GitHub remote
parameters.descriptionZh: 仓库，格式 "owner/repo"；缺省用当前工作区的 GitHub remote

parameters.name: number
parameters.descriptionZh: issue 或 PR 编号

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag or SHA for list_checks; a pull request number also works
parameters.descriptionZh: list_checks 的分支 / 标签 / SHA，也接受 PR 编号（取其 head SHA）

parameters.name: state
parameters.descriptionZh: 列表过滤：open（默认）/ closed / all

parameters.name: page
parameters.descriptionZh: 列表页码，每页 30 条

descriptionZh: 读取 GitHub 仓库数据：列出/获取 issue、issue 评论、列出/获取 Pull Request、PR 的统一 diff、以及指定 ref 的 CI 检查结果。仓库默认取当前工作区 remote，也可用 repo 参数指定。需要已保存 github.com 凭据（token）。

name: githubWrite
title: GitHub write
description: Writes to GitHub: create/update/comment on issues, create pull requests, submit PR reviews (APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGES / COMMENT), and merge pull requests. Defaults to the workspace repository. Every call requires user confirmation.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: create_issue / update_issue / comment_issue / create_pull / review_pull / merge_pull

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as "owner/repo"; defaults to the workspace GitHub remote
parameters.descriptionZh: 仓库，格式 "owner/repo"；缺省用当前工作区的 GitHub remote

parameters.name: number
parameters.descriptionZh: issue 或 PR 编号

parameters.name: title
parameters.descriptionZh: issue / PR 标题

parameters.name: body
parameters.descriptionZh: Markdown 正文或评论内容

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Target state for update_issue: open / closed
parameters.descriptionZh: update_issue 目标状态：open / closed

parameters.name: head
parameters.descriptionZh: create_pull 源分支

parameters.name: base
parameters.descriptionZh: create_pull 目标分支

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Review verdict for review_pull: APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGES / COMMENT
parameters.descriptionZh: review_pull 审查结论：APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGES / COMMENT

parameters.name: merge_method
parameters.description: Merge strategy for merge_pull: merge (default) / squash / rebase
parameters.descriptionZh: merge_pull 合并方式：merge（默认）/ squash / rebase

descriptionZh: 写入 GitHub：创建/更新/评论 issue、创建 Pull Request、提交 PR 审查（通过 / 请求修改 / 评论）以及合并 PR。默认操作当前工作区仓库，每次调用前需要用户确认。

name: planMode
title: Plan mode
description: Enters or leaves PLAN mode: read-only exploration and design for complex changes. Leaving opens a plan-review panel; coding starts only after the user approves.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: enter (start planning) / exit (finish and request review)
parameters.descriptionZh: enter（进入计划模式）/ exit（退出并请求审查）

parameters.name: reason
parameters.descriptionZh: 进入/退出的原因说明

descriptionZh: 进入或退出 PLAN 模式：只读探索并设计复杂改动，退出时打开计划审查面板，用户批准后才开始写代码。

name: todo
title: Task list
description: Maintains the session task list by submitting the full items array. Supports priorities and status transitions, displayed live in the UI.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: Full task list (subject / description / priority / status)
parameters.descriptionZh: 完整任务列表（subject / description / priority / status）

descriptionZh: 维护会话任务清单：整体提交 items 数组（全量替换），支持优先级与状态流转，界面实时显示进度。

name: memory
title: Memory
description: Reads and writes cross-session memory files: save, read, list, edit and delete, in project or global scope.

parameters.name: name
parameters.descriptionZh: 记忆条目名

parameters.name: content
parameters.descriptionZh: save 时的正文内容

parameters.name: scope
parameters.descriptionZh: project（当前项目）/ global（全局）

descriptionZh: 读写跨会话记忆文件：保存要点、阅读、列表、编辑与删除，支持项目与全局两个作用域。

name: loadSkill
title: Load skill
description: Loads a skill's instruction body into context. Skills are distilled playbooks for recurring workflows and project conventions.

parameters.name: skill_name
parameters.description: Skill name (see the available-skills list in the system prompt)
parameters.descriptionZh: 技能名称（见系统提示词内的可用技能清单）

descriptionZh: 把某个技能的指令正文加载进上下文。技能是沉淀的领域操作手册（工作流、规范、脚本用法）。

name: generateImage
title: Generate image
description: Generates images from a text prompt and shows them in chat. Supports size, count, quality and style, optionally saving to the workspace.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.descriptionZh: 图片提示词

parameters.name: size
parameters.descriptionZh: 尺寸档位

parameters.name: n
parameters.descriptionZh: 生成张数

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.descriptionZh: 保存到工作区的路径

descriptionZh: 按文字提示生成图片并展示在对话里，可指定尺寸、数量、质量与风格，可选保存到工作区。

name: askUserQuestion
title: Ask user question
description: Asks the user to confirm requirements or key decisions with choice questions; supports multiple questions and multi-select.

parameters.name: questions
parameters.descriptionZh: 问题列表（question / header / options / multiSelect）

descriptionZh: 以选择题形式向用户确认需求或关键决策，可一次提多个问题、允许多选。

name: task
title: Subagents
description: Creates and manages subagents: independent context with full tools, running in parallel (up to 5). Send messages, read output, stop or delete; the system notifies when they finish, so no polling.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: create (default) / send / read / stop / del / list
parameters.descriptionZh: create（默认）/ send / read / stop / del / list

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Task description for create (used as the session title)
parameters.descriptionZh: create 时的任务简述（作为会话标题）

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.descriptionZh: create 时的完整任务指令

parameters.name: id
parameters.descriptionZh: 子会话 id（read / send / stop / del）

parameters.name: message
parameters.descriptionZh: send 时的消息内容

descriptionZh: 创建并管理子代理：各自拥有独立上下文与完整工具集，可并行运行（最多 5 个）。支持发消息、读取输出、停止与删除；完成时系统自动通知，无需轮询。

name: messageParent
title: Message parent
description: Lets a subagent message its parent session: report progress or request coordination and decisions. Async and non-blocking; replies arrive as later messages.

parameters.name: message
parameters.descriptionZh: 要发送的消息

descriptionZh: 子代理向父会话发消息：同步进度、请求协调或决策。异步不阻塞，回复会以后续消息送达。

name: manageMcp
title: MCP management
description: Adds, removes and lists MCP servers. Changes Agent config only; it does not install runtimes such as Node/Python.

parameters.name: server_name
parameters.descriptionZh: 服务器名

parameters.name: command
parameters.descriptionZh: add_stdio 的启动命令

parameters.name: url
parameters.descriptionZh: add_http 的服务器地址

descriptionZh: 添加、移除、列出 MCP 服务器。修改的是 Agent 配置，不负责安装 Node/Python 等运行时。

name: browser
title: Browser
description: Controls the built-in browser for automation: multiple tabs, navigation, clicks, form filling, screenshots, accessibility tree and console logs — commonly used for page verification and web operations.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: navigate / click / fill / select / press / scroll / getText / getHtml / getBackbone / screenshot / evaluate / console / dialog / wait / listTabs / newTab / closeTab / selectTab and more
parameters.descriptionZh: navigate / click / fill / select / press / scroll / getText / getHtml / getBackbone / screenshot / evaluate / console / dialog / wait / listTabs / newTab / closeTab / selectTab 等

parameters.name: url
parameters.descriptionZh: navigate 的目标地址

parameters.name: selector
parameters.descriptionZh: 元素选择器（CSS / ref= / text= / xpath=）

parameters.name: value
parameters.descriptionZh: fill / select 的取值

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: Target tab id (defaults to the active tab)
parameters.descriptionZh: 目标标签页 id（缺省当前标签）

descriptionZh: 控制内置浏览器做自动化：多标签页、导航、点击、填表、截图、读取无障碍树与控制台日志，常用于页面验证与网页操作。
